policies.name: public.taskboard_notification_preferences.preferences_self_insert
policies.check: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ( SELECT taskboard_account_active() AS taskboard_account_active))

policies.name: public.taskboard_notification_preferences.preferences_self_read
policies.using: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ( SELECT taskboard_account_active() AS taskboard_account_active))

policies.name: public.taskboard_notification_preferences.preferences_self_update
policies.check: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ( SELECT taskboard_account_active() AS taskboard_account_active))
policies.using: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) AND ( SELECT taskboard_account_active() AS taskboard_account_active))

policies.name: public.taskboard_team_invitations.invitations_create_admin
policies.check:
((invited_by = auth.uid()) AND taskboard_manage_team(team_id) AND ((role <> 'admin'::text) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM taskboard_teams t
  WHERE ((t.id = taskboard_team_invitations.team_id) AND (t.owner_id = auth.uid()))))) AND (accepted_at IS NULL) AND (expires_at > now()) AND (expires_at <= (now() + '7 days'::interval)) AND (char_length(token_hash) >= 64))

policies.name: public.taskboard_team_members.members_manage_admin
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM taskboard_teams t
  WHERE ((t.id = taskboard_team_members.team_id) AND (t.owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)))))

policies.name: public.taskboard_team_members.members_read_self
policies.using: ((user_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR is_taskboard_team_member(team_id))

policies.name: public.taskboard_teams.teams_read_owner
policies.using: ((owner_id = ( SELECT auth.uid() AS uid)) OR is_taskboard_team_member(id))
